`final class ColorGradient`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.color` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ColorGradient.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/color/ColorGradient.java)

The two stops and the direction of a linear gradient, carried by a gradient `Color`.

## Description

You rarely build one yourself: [`Color.toGradient`](/reference/drawing/color/#Color-method-toGradient) and [`Color.decode`](/reference/drawing/color/#Color-factory-decode) with `gradient(...)` create the gradient color for you.
The points are on 1 of the drawn area, so the same gradient fits a node of any size.

- [Colors and styling](/use/learn/style-and-motion/styling/)

### of

## Method details

<a id="ColorGradient-method-use"></a>

### use

`void use(Runnable runnable, BoundingBox canvas)` 

Runs `runnable` with the gradient shader bound and spread over `canvas`, in the coordinates you draw in, then restores the previous shader.

`void use(boolean hasTexture, Runnable runnable, BoundingBox canvas)` 

Runs `runnable` with the gradient shader bound over `canvas`, then restores the previous shader; if `hasTexture` is `true`, the gradient multiplies the bound texture instead of replacing it.
